population: Existing 259 completed French-author translation pairs, 2000–2025; not the full corpus.

models.adjusted: chrF ~ intercept + (year-2000)/10 + French mean sentence words + French mean tree depth + log French document word count

uncertainty: Percentile author-cluster bootstrap; authors sampled with replacement, all their documents retained. No multiplicity correction.
interpretation: This comparison checks whether the similarity trend persists after accounting for the measured French-source properties. It cannot separate MT use from other explanations, such as changing topics or overlap with the model’s training data.
